description: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes of six different multilingual BERT models—XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-B₂, and mBERT-B₂—across four morphosyntactic tagging categories: “case,” “gender,” “number,” and “tense.” The horizontal axis represents these four categorical tags, ordered from left to right, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” measures the magnitude of the effect size on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. Each tag category contains six grouped bars, each corresponding to one of the six models, color-coded according to the legend: light blue for XLM-L₂, dark blue for mBERT-R₂, light green for XLM-R₂, dark green for mBERT-B₂, light red for XLM-B₂, and dark red for mBERT-B₂. For the “case” category, the bars show the following approximate effect sizes: XLM-L₂ (~6), mBERT-R₂ (~5), XLM-R₂ (~2), mBERT-B₂ (~12), XLM-B₂ (~11), and mBERT-B₂ (~11). For “gender,” the values are approximately: XLM-L₂ (~1), mBERT-R₂ (~2), XLM-R₂ (~1), mBERT-B₂ (~4), XLM-B₂ (~3), and mBERT-B₂ (~3). For “number,” the values are approximately: XLM-L₂ (~1), mBERT-R₂ (~1), XLM-R₂ (~1), mBERT-B₂ (~3), XLM-B₂ (~2), and mBERT-B₂ (~2). For “tense,” all bars are very short, with approximate values around 0.5 for XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-B₂, and mBERT-B₂ respectively. Each bar is accompanied by a vertical error bar indicating the uncertainty of the effect size. The bars are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
